description: This file is an HTML source for a web-based database visualizer interface. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side scripting to list databases, tables, and display table data with interactive features.
external_files: fetch API calls to endpoints like /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, /api/{db}/tables/{table}/data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list, loading tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, limited to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts HTML for table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
